title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree III
description: Find the lowest common ancestor of two nodes in a binary tree where nodes have parent pointers.
pseudocode:
1: pPtr = p, qPtr = q
2: while pPtr !== qPtr:
3:   pPtr = pPtr == null ? q : pPtr.parent
4:   qPtr = qPtr == null ? p : qPtr.parent
5: return pPtr

steps.note: Initialize two pointers pPtr and qPtr to nodes p and q.
pPtr (5) is not equal to qPtr (1). Enter loop.
Move pPtr to parent of 5, which is 3.
Move qPtr to parent of 1, which is 3.
pPtr (3) is equal to qPtr (3). Exit loop.
